reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code verified at receive_block.go:516-517. Execution request errors (deposit/withdrawal/consolidation validation failures wrapped in execReqErr) are returned raw without invalidBlock wrapper. This bypasses fork choice invalidation. Spec (Fulu beacon-chain SG-001) does not mandate this differential treatment; all state transition failures should mark block as invalid.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu beacon-chain SG-001 (get_blob_parameters): spec requires consistent block invalidation for state transition failures, no exception for execution requests

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code verified at validate_beacon_blocks.go:498-501. The early-return (L498-501) when head slot/proposer mismatch is by-design: equivocation only applies when SAME slot+proposer produces TWO different blocks. If head has moved to different slot or proposer, there is no equivocation. Signature was already verified during initial gossip validation before caching. EIP-7951 SG-003 spec describes signature verification flow but does not mandate re-verification on cache hits for non-equivocations.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: EIP-7951 SG-003 (signature_verification): spec enforces signature check on first submission; dedup for same slot+proposer is design intent, not a bypass

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code verified at state_trie.go:649-652. InitializeFromProtoUnsafeFulu directly copies protobuf proposer_lookahead without length validation, while SetProposerLookahead enforces exact length check (L18-19). SSZ deserialization and DB loads can inject arbitrary-length arrays, violating invariant. Spec SG-008 INV-003 explicitly requires length = (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH after epoch processing.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu beacon-chain SG-008 (process_proposer_lookahead) INV-003: proposer_lookahead length must remain (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code verified at validate_data_column.go:157 and subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go:42. Classic TOCTOU: check (L157) happens during validation, set (L42) happens in post-validation handler. Two concurrent goroutines both read cache-miss, both return ValidationAccept before either marks as seen. No mutex guards the check-set sequence. Spec SG-006 INV-004 defines dedup key (slot, proposer_index, sidecar.index) but requires atomicity to prevent duplicates.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu p2p-interface SG-006 (data_column_sidecar_gossip_validation) INV-004: deduplication key must prevent duplicate acceptance, requires atomic check-and-set

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code verified at rpc_data_column_sidecars_by_root.go:123. RPC handler serves data columns directly from storage with no state transition validation check. Storage writes happen asynchronously before block validation completes. Spec SG-009 INV-005 explicitly states 'Sidecars should not be served for blocks failing beacon-chain state transition', but no such check exists in the RPC handler code path.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu p2p-interface SG-009 (data_column_sidecars_by_root) INV-005: Sidecars should not be served for blocks failing beacon-chain state transition
